note: Reviewed rules applied by scripts/merge_checklist_fills.py. `aliases` map a reader's spelling of an object onto the canonical object; `exclude` drops fills for an object that does not exist; `resolutions` move specific readings out of the base value into a named variant because the frame shows a modified value. Values are never edited here; only names and classification, each with its evidence.

exclude.name: Bombard
exclude.reason: Created from one unnamed selection panel with a 'Cannon (Siege)' weapon (qlogYcWhKEU). The 17.0 datamined Scots roster has no Bombard (it has Culverin, Ribauldequin and the Dhun Eideann cannons), so the panel belongs to another unit.

resolutions.name: Villager
resolutions.variant: unit record value, not charged (Northern Migration recruits at no cost)
resolutions.reason: Vikings start with 0 food and food stays 0 while villagers appear (ehO1BOe7wG8 s_00141/s_00174, uNw-K34ZDPs s_00048); the Vikings villager tooltip shows only the clock, no cost (nd74LibluQ0 s_00125, ehO1BOe7wG8 s_00166); Northern Migration: 'Town Centers automatically recruit Villagers at no cost'. The 50 food in the datamined record and the 16.3 catalog is the shared base-unit value, not what a Viking pays.
